name: example_cds_route
notes: Offline fallback: give the CDS start/end on the amplicon reference. Needs no network and no reference files. amplicon_reference is documentation only; the pipeline never reads it. The coordinates above are the longest ORF of that 529 bp amplicon (ATG..TAG, 120 bp = 40 codons) and are meant as a working example: replace them with the CDS of your own amplicon. The CDS length MUST be a multiple of 3 - otherwise the annotation is skipped and the reason is recorded in qc.tsv and run_manifest.json.
